name: The Exam Generator Database
description: An exam generator generates exams from entered topics and questions: type the topics, press Generate, and read the exam. Marks of 5, 5, 10, 10 and 20 total 50. A pass mark of 60 percent on 50 marks is 30. 8 right out of 10 is 80.0 percent. Everything runs in this browser; no data leaves the page.
